notes: The first fix-typed run: a chain-only workflow:fix node dispatched under the cockpit driver, and the run the fix type dir exists for. Its six nodes (standards-discovery, reproduce, fix, verify, fix-approval, close-out) live under the frozen workflow: block with node_summaries beside it, the fix-approval gate is answered via file by the dispatching operator, and close-out carries the declared fix_outcome. What it pins that the change fixture cannot: reproduce declares red_proven, the value the fix node is guarded on, recorded true here because the reproduction failed for the stated reason - a run whose red was never proved records false and shows fix skipped instead. Artifacts keep the A4 layout across both registered subdirectories: implementation/tdd-red-gate.md opens with the A5 summary block, implementation/work-log.md is on the A5 exempt list and carries none, and verification/verification-report.md is A5-registered and opens with one. The close-out is the branch where no pull request is required. Synthetic rather than sampled: the run it describes is the shape a dispatched fix run writes, built to the same schemas the sampled runs are held to, with no absolute path belonging to anyone.
